title: Mighty Fighter
description: Mighty fighter, the mighty fighter look, is a living champion posed like cabinet art: oversized stance, hard rim, toy-box color, the city small behind them. It is a lock-off win pose, not a camera move and not motion blur.

sections.title: Narrative function

blocks.text: Title cards, arrivals, comic action: one figure, three-quarter low, stance wider than polite, background as a stage. Clothes may be stylized or street, but the body is a fighting-game select screen.
A whispering drama does not need a sprite. It is the wrong tool when the person should look tired and real, or when you wanted plastic merchandise.
If they look documentary, you missed the toy-box. If they look like a doll, you wandered into action-figure.

sections.title: Questions

blocks.text: What is Mighty Fighter in film?
A posed champion look: low three-quarter, oversized stance, hard rim, toy-box color. It is cabinet art of a living body, not a camera move and not a plastic toy.
Mighty Fighter vs Action Figure
Action figure is merchandise: joints, polymer, blister-card light. Mighty fighter is a living sprite in a win pose. If you can see rivets, you crossed.
When should I use Mighty Fighter?
Title cards, arrivals, comic action. Skip whispering drama and documentary tiredness.
How do I prompt Mighty Fighter for AI image or video?
